description.zh: 为企业、政府、城市、园区、学校和产品策划宣传片：2–3 个创意方向、分段画面构想、按时长写的解说词和片名，拍摄计划与制作周期，以及带公式的预算表 Excel；也能写招商片和年会 VCR 方案。
description.en: Plans promo videos for companies, governments, cities, parks, schools, and products: creative directions, scene ideas, timed narration and titles, shooting plans and schedules, and a formula-driven budget sheet.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我为谁拍、给谁看、片长和预算，我来出创意方案和预算表
welcome_message.en: Tell me who it's for, the audience, length, and budget — I'll draft the concept and budget

prompt.zh: 帮我策划一部 ___ 分钟的企业宣传片。公司：___；用途：___；预算大约：___。
prompt.en: Plan a ___-minute corporate film. Company: ___; purpose: ___; budget about: ___.

prompt.zh: 帮我策划 ___ 的城市宣传片，片长 ___ 分钟，想突出：___。
prompt.en: Plan a city promo for ___, ___ minutes long, highlighting: ___.

prompt.zh: 帮我写一篇 ___ 分钟宣传片的解说词，主题：___，素材和数据如下：
prompt.en: Write narration for a ___-minute promo. Theme: ___. Material and data:

prompt.zh: 帮我策划 ___ 园区的招商宣传片，主导产业：___，优势政策：___。
prompt.en: Plan an investment promo for ___ park. Key industries: ___; policies: ___.

prompt.zh: 帮我策划一段 ___ 分钟的年会开场 VCR，公司今年的关键事件：
prompt.en: Plan a ___-minute year-end opening VCR. This year's key events:

prompt.zh: 帮我把下面的制作报价整理成预算表 Excel，管理费 ___%，税率 ___%：
prompt.en: Turn this quote into a budget spreadsheet. Overhead ___%, tax ___%:

zh: 每周一「10:00」汇总本周宣传片项目的进度和待确认事项
每次审片后第二天「09:30」把审片意见整理成修改清单
每月 1 日「10:00」根据项目计划更新制作周期表，标出延期风险
每周三「15:00」检查本周新增的报价，更新预算表
每年 11 月 15 日「09:00」起草年会 VCR 的策划方案
每周五「17:00」整理下周拍摄需要办理的许可和报备事项
en: Every Monday at 10:00, summarize progress and open items for this week's promo projects
The day after each review at 09:30, turn feedback into a revision list
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, update the production schedule and flag delays
Every Wednesday at 15:00, update the budget sheet with new quotes
On November 15 each year at 09:00, draft the year-end VCR plan
Every Friday at 17:00, list permits and filings needed for next week's shoots
